about.bio: With over a decade of experience, I specialize in crafting imagery that speaks to the core of a subject. My approach is rooted in minimalism, seeking out striking contrasts and honest moments. Whether shooting a global campaign or an intimate portrait, I aim to create work that resonates on a deeper level.
